caption: Castel Sismondo, Rimini
composition: Malatesta brick fortress with round towers and dry moat · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The brick fortress fills the left and center, its great arched gateway flanked by a massive round tower. To the right the long curtain wall with its machicolated parapet stretches toward another round tower, the dry moat running between. Bright 12:52 midday sun blazes on the brickwork under a deep blue sky.
